title: A Safe and Happy School
summary: Keeping clean and healthy, stopping germs from spreading, first aid, and safety rules at school.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 4: Our School — A Happy Place

objectives: I can explain how germs spread.
I can follow hygiene and safety rules.
I can help make my school clean and kind.
misconceptions: Water alone is enough to wash off germs.
Germs only spread when you touch someone.
Safety rules are only for grown-ups.
